avoid.verdict: At $109.99 it costs more than the Aqara M3, and its listing can't decide whether it supports third-party Zigbee devices.
reasons: One bullet says it supports Tuya Zigbee devices only, "not third-party Zigbee devices." Another says it supports "three-party standard zigbee."
It claims CSA certification but gives no certificate or product ID.
Its uplink connects to the cloud, per the listing; only some automations run locally.
It has 2.9 stars, the lowest rating of any hub we looked at for this page.
